source: three REAL_ROOT brains registered internally (task0044-seed-proof.py). Every interaction is a real mouse event dispatched through the browser input pipeline (CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent): clicks, real wheel notches, a real drag. Every logical value is read back from the catalogue (map_brain_resume_state) and from the real screen; the resume writes the product itself makes are counted on the wire (CDP Network). Two REAL closes of the process, the source changed while the application is closed.

resumeWritesMadeByTheProductOnTheWire.eachBodyChecked: no absolute path, no filter cursor, no name; the closed five-key state

limits: No personal brain: the analysed trees were generated by task0044-seed-proof.py and die with the proof root

The closes are normal ones (the window is asked to close); the resume state is not claimed to survive a crash of the process: a change made within the last debounce window (250 ms) of a hard kill is not guaranteed
Real mouse events are dispatched through the browser input pipeline by the harness (CDP); a physical mouse, touch or keyboard-only navigation is not exercised here
The persistent state covers a single brain on screen: a composition of several brains is still session-only (DEC-0042 section 7), and the camera of a composition is not stored for any one brain
After Reconstruire a stored node id is checked for existence only: a rebuilt Index may give an old id to another node (Actualiser keeps identities and is the covered path)
P-19 stays partial: no FR/EN choice, no accessibility preferences, no legend preference and no multi-brain composition persistence in this slice
Development workstation, local NTFS disk; not a modest-laptop acceptance test
